text:
Ellen (PM): Quick sync: GTM wants a concise "Finance Observability" deliverable — per-route cost exports, trace->cost linking for audits, and an error fingerprint view. We have limited eng capacity this quarter (1.5 FTE). Can we agree a conservative Pilot scope?

Vic (Eng-Platform): From infra perspective the low-effort path is aggregated exports + a small index from route -> sampled_trace_ids. Exact per-invocation attribution touches billing/runtime and is GA-only. Estimate: 2 sprints for Pilot.

Marta (Eng-ML): We can produce est_cost + confidence_pct using model token profiles. Recommend adaptive sampling: higher for errors and high-est-cost outliers so audits see real cases.

Sam (CS): Customers will accept "ESTIMATED" for hosted preview as long as migration to Dedicated audited numbers is clear. Need export CSV shaped for finance (route, start, end, tokens_est, cost_est, confidence_pct, note).

Ellen (PM): Proposed Pilot (hosted):
- Aggregated CSV export (per-route/time window) marked ESTIMATED
- Route -> sampled trace linking (min 3 samples if available)
- Error fingerprint table (top 20) with sample trace and quick RCA tag
GA (dedicated/private): audited per-invocation attribution + nightly reconcile + downloadable audited CSV.

Vic (Eng-Platform): Agreed. Implementation notes: emit model_version and batching_mode in metrics to detect estimator drift; sampling policy to be adaptive; ensure exports scrub PII.

Marta (Eng-ML): I'll run a 3-day spike to validate estimator correlation across current model fleet and provide a small API shape (est_cost, confidence_pct).

Sam (CS): I'll line up two pilot customers willing to test "Preview - Estimated" and draft messaging + migration playbook.

ticket-bot: Created ticket FIN-421: "finance-observability pilot: aggregated exports + trace linking + fingerprints" assigned to eng-platform, eng-ml. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-421

Ellen (PM): Acceptance criteria for Pilot:
- UI: Finance exports page with route selector, time-range, export CSV button
- CSV: [route, start_ts, end_ts, tokens_est, cost_est, confidence_pct, note=ESTIMATED]
- Trace linking: clicking a route shows sampled traces pane (min 3 examples when available)
- Fingerprint view: top 20 fingerprints, count, sample_trace_id, RCA tag
- Docs: clear "Estimated hosted numbers" label + migration playbook

Vic (Eng-Platform): Risks: estimator drift when quantization/ batching changes. We'll add model tagging and nightly recalibration checks.

Marta (Eng-ML): Deliverables: spike doc + sample CSV + suggested sampling config by Wed EOD.

Sam (CS): I'll gather pilot contacts and draft customer-facing language.

Ellen (PM): Thanks all. If spikes look good we'll start pilot rollout in ~3 weeks. :thumbsup:
